      "text": "Welcome to the \"Early Hardmode Wall.\" This is widely considered the hardest difficulty spike in Terraria, especially since your accessories (Shield of Cthulhu and Worm Scarf) indicate you are playing on **Expert Mode**.\n\nIn Expert Hardmode, you cannot \"face-tank\" bosses anymore. You need specific gear to survive.\n\nHere is a step-by-step guide to getting your first kill (aim for **The Destroyer** first).\n\n### 1. The \"Cheese\" Weapon: Daedalus Stormbow\nIf you are struggling, this weapon is the answer. It rains arrows from the sky and shreds the Destroyer.\n*   **How to get it:** Go to the Underground Hallow. Collect 15 **Souls of Light**. Craft a **Key of Light** at a workbench. Put the key inside an **empty Chest** and close it. This spawns a **Hallowed Mimic**.\n    *   *Warning:* The Mimic is a mini-boss. Build a long flat platform to run away from it while shooting.\n    *   Kill it until it drops the **Daedalus Stormbow**.\n*   **The Ammo:** Do not use normal arrows. Craft **Holy Arrows** (200 Arrows + 3 Pixie Dust + 1 Unicorn Horn). These spawn falling stars on impact.\n\n### 2. Upgrade Your Ammo (Crucial)\nI see **Musket Balls** in your ammo slot. **Throw these away.** In Hardmode, basic ammo does almost 0 damage to bosses because of their high defense.\n*   **For Guns:** Use **Crystal Bullets** (Musket Ball + Crystal Shard) or **Ichor Bullets** (Musket Ball + Ichor from Crimson underground). Ichor lowers boss defense, which is vital in Expert mode.\n*   **For Bows:** Holy Arrows (as mentioned above) or Ichor Arrows.\n\n### 3. Armor Progression\nYou appear to be wearing early Hardmode ore armor (Cobalt/Palladium). It is likely not enough defense.\n*   Go mine **Mythril/Orichalcum**, then make that pickaxe.\n*   Mine **Adamantite or Titanium**.\n*   **Goal:** Craft a full set of **Titanium Armor** (the Shadow Dodge set bonus saves your life) or **Adamantite Armor**.\n*   *Alternative:* If you are a Ranger/Melee hybrid, go to the Snow Biome when it is raining and kill Ice Golems to get **Frost Armor**. It gives great defense and frostburn damage.\n\n### 4. Accessory Reforging\nYou have the Goblin Tinkerer. You need to spend your gold (I see you have about 2 Platinum).\n*   Take your Worm Scarf, Shield of Cthulhu, Boots, and Wings to him.\n*   Reforge them until they all say **Warding** (+4 Defense) or **Menacing** (+4% Damage).\n*   **Warding** is much better if you are dying too fast. That extra 20+ defense makes a massive difference.\n\n### 5. Other Strong Weapons\nIf you don\u0027t want to use the Bow method, get these:\n*   **Ranger:** **Onyx Blaster**. It requires a Shotgun (Sold by Arms Dealer), 2 Dark Shards (Corrupt/Crimson Mummies), and 10 Souls of Night. It hits like a truck.\n*   **Melee:** **Shadowflame Knife**. Wait for a Goblin Army invasion. The Goblin Summoner drops this. It is a melee weapon that you can throw from a distance. Infinite ammo, safe distance.\n*   **Melee:** **Dao of Pow**. Go to the shimmering sand in the desert, farm Light/Dark shards, and make this flail. It confuses enemies and does heavy damage.\n\n### 6. Potions (Do not skip this)\nIn Expert Hardmode, you must use alchemy.\n*   **Ironskin Potion:** (+8 Defense)\n*   **Regeneration Potion:** (Health regen)\n*   **Swiftness Potion:** (Movement speed)\n*   **Food:** Eat a Pumpkin Pie or any food item to get the \"Well Fed\" buff. It increases all stats.\n\n### Summary of the Plan:\n1.  Farm Souls of Light in the Hallow.\n2.  Kill Hallowed Mimics to get the **Daedalus Stormbow**.\n3.  Craft **Holy Arrows**.\n4.  Wait for night, summon **The Destroyer**.\n5.  Build a platform high in the sky (but not too high, or Wyverns will spawn).\n6.  Rain arrows down on the worm. The stars from the Holy Arrows will hit multiple segments, killing it in seconds.\n\nOnce you beat the Destroyer, you can make the **Megashark** (using the Souls of Might it drops), and the rest of the game becomes much easier. Good luck!",
